name: Slonks Pixel Canvas
description: An optional paint layer for Slonks: holders can paint pixels over their token that the renderer composites on top.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This contract stores a per-token paint layer for Slonks. Holders can paint or clear individual pixels (and animation frames) on their token; the **SlonksRenderer** (`0x726383bd28fa1f95a7e3d300babf08f6444d0437`) reads this layer and composites it over the model-generated image when serving the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`).

paintPixel.title: Paint Pixel
paintPixel.description: Paint a single pixel of your token with an RGB color.

clearPixel.title: Clear Pixel
clearPixel.description: Remove the paint from a single pixel of your token.

paintFramePixel.title: Paint Frame Pixel
paintFramePixel.description: Paint a single pixel on a specific animation frame of your token.

duplicateFrame.title: Duplicate Frame
duplicateFrame.description: Copy an existing animation frame into a new frame on your token.

paintedPixelCount.title: Painted Pixel Count
paintedPixelCount.description: How many pixels are currently painted on a token.

frameCount.title: Frame Count
frameCount.description: How many animation frames a token currently has.

paintedPixel.title: Painted Pixel
paintedPixel.description: Whether a given pixel is painted and, if so, its color.

setRenderer.title: Set Renderer
setRenderer.description: Set the renderer authorized to read this paint layer. Only the owner can call this.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer ownership of the paint-layer contract. Only the owner can call this.
